label_origin: Assistant-proposed analyst-judgment labels, authored before this evaluation run; not human or supervisor approved.
review_requirement: Human reviewer and supervisor must review these provisional labels independently. Do not relabel to match CDSS output.
criteria: Prioritize observed suspicious outcomes, related activity and business importance. These are qualitative analyst judgments, not a transcription of the CDSS matrix.

scenarios.description: One failed authentication against a low-business-importance laboratory server.
scenarios.expected_evidence: One failure, no corroborating success or later activity.
scenarios.reference_rationale: An isolated attempt on a low-impact asset merits routine review, not urgent escalation.

scenarios.description: Two separate failed authentications from the same source against the same account within one minute.
scenarios.expected_evidence: Related failures; no subsequent successful authentication.
scenarios.reference_rationale: Repeated targeted attempts warrant timely investigation but do not demonstrate access.

scenarios.description: Two failed authentications followed by success for the same source, account and high-importance server.
scenarios.expected_evidence: Two failures and a later related successful login, without confirmed compromise.
scenarios.reference_rationale: A suspicious access sequence affecting important services deserves urgent authorization review; legitimate login remains possible.

scenarios.description: Related authentication failures and success followed by a security-relevant configuration-file integrity event on a critical server.
scenarios.expected_evidence: Actual later syscheck event associated with the same source/account context.
scenarios.reference_rationale: Potential progression and critical business exposure justify urgent human review; no automatic compromise verdict.

scenarios.description: Generic Windows detection with no specific investigation playbook or supported suspicious outcome.
scenarios.expected_evidence: One generic alert, insufficient evidence to characterize activity.
scenarios.reference_rationale: An analyst should clarify the ambiguous detection in a timely manner. This is a review priority, not an assertion of maliciousness.

scenarios.description: A single failed authentication targets a critical authentication service; no additional activity is observed.
scenarios.expected_evidence: Limited direct evidence on a business-critical service.
scenarios.reference_rationale: A conservative analyst may urgently verify an attempt against a critical service despite limited evidence; business sensitivity motivates this priority.

scenarios.description: Separate related authentication failures repeatedly target one account on a low-importance server.
scenarios.expected_evidence: Repeated failures without success; low asset criticality.
scenarios.reference_rationale: Repeated account targeting deserves timely investigation even on a low-impact asset; attempted credential abuse matters beyond asset value.

scenarios.description: Failures, related successful authentication and a subsequent security-relevant configuration change occur on a low-importance server.
scenarios.expected_evidence: A supported temporal sequence with a later integrity observation.
scenarios.reference_rationale: The combination of access and later security-relevant activity warrants urgent verification regardless of the server's limited business importance.
